release_notes:
v2.0.5836 – Identity & Timer Update

🔹 Identity Confirmation (NEW):
- Tool now asks users to confirm their name after API setup.
- Fixes bug where everyone appeared as 'Arnolfo Bambao'.
- New ✏️ My Name button to change identity anytime.
- Names are logged for auditing.

🔹 Full-Name Only Mode (NEW):
- Default team lists no longer show first names (Alex, Arnolfo, etc.).
- Reset to Default clears the list for clean re-selection.

🔹 Sandtime.io API:
- Uses official /organization endpoint.
- Detailed auth errors (401, 403, 404, TIMEOUT).

🔹 Live Debug Log:
- 🔍 View Logs button on Time Tracking panel.
- Color-coded, filterable, saveable.
- Log resets every session.

🔹 Timer Safeguards:
- 65s Stop cooldown.
- 30s Start lockout after stopping.
- Auto-pause on 5 min idle.

🔹 Desync Detection:
- Auto-recovers if Sandtime stops the timer externally.

🔹 Compatibility:
- Backwards compatible with all existing data.
